crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The sample is identified as the 'Oracle VirtualBox Extension Pack Helper App' (VBoxExtPackHelperApp.exe), a legitimate utility used by VirtualBox to manage the installation and removal of extension packs. Analysis shows typical administrative utility behaviors: it requests elevation via ShellExecuteExW with the 'runas' verb, checks for Administrator SID (S-1-5-32-544), and performs integrity checks using SHA-256 and internal hardening APIs (SUPR3HardenedVerify). The presence of Oracle-specific strings, PDB paths (D:\tinderboxa\win-7.1\...), and references to ExtPack.manifest/ExtPack.signature confirm its authenticity. No malicious indicators or suspicious network/persistence mechanisms were found.
